_readme: Single source of truth for every dimension. Units are millimetres and degrees.
Do NOT put your measurements here. Put them in params/measured.json as a flat
{"name": value} object (see params/measured.example.json). That file is picked
up automatically by the CLI, rhino/build_all.py and the Grasshopper Params component.
"placeholder": true marks a value that is not confirmed for YOUR car yet. With
"basis": "reference" it is an estimate (from the outside dimensions of other
models and the car) for the test prints to confirm; without it, a guess to measure.
Coordinates: x = right (seen from the driver), y = from the front lip into the dash,
z = up from the Qi pad surface. See docs/measuring.md.

W_ref.doc: Cubby width 10 mm behind the front lip, at height z_ref. Estimate; see envelope_offset.

z_ref.doc: Height above the Qi pad at which W_ref and wall_lean_deg are given. If you measure, measure there.

wall_lean_deg.doc: Lean of each side wall at z_ref, seen from the front. Positive = the cubby gets wider going up.

wall_radius.doc: Radius of the side walls seen from the front: they curve in toward the floor. 0 = straight walls.

W_rear_delta.doc: Width 10 mm in front of the rear wall minus width 10 mm behind the lip, at the same height. Negative = the cubby narrows toward the rear.

D_cubby.doc: Depth from the front lip to the rear wall, above the plugs. Estimate.

H_cubby.doc: Height of the flat part of the roof above the Qi pad. Estimate; the profile gauge checks it.

rear_corner_length.doc: Rear corners seen from above: a chamfer that starts this far in front of the rear wall on the side wall ... (0 = plain corner rounded with rear_corner_r_back).

rear_corner_inset.doc: ... and ends this far in from the side wall on the rear wall.

rear_corner_r_side.doc: Fillet radius where the rear-corner chamfer meets the side wall.

rear_corner_r_back.doc: Fillet radius where the rear-corner chamfer meets the rear wall.

roof_pocket_rise.doc: Some RAV4 versions have a raised pocket in the middle of the roof toward the front (an arch-shaped recess at the cabin-facing edge): how much higher than H_cubby it is, 10 mm behind the lip. 0 = no pocket: on the GR Sport PHEV the front edge of the roof is straight.

roof_pocket_width.doc: Roof pocket (only used if roof_pocket_rise > 0): width of its full-height part.

roof_pocket_blend.doc: Roof pocket (only used if roof_pocket_rise > 0): width of the smooth transition on each side.

roof_pocket_end.doc: Roof pocket (only used if roof_pocket_rise > 0): distance from the lip where it has flattened out to H_cubby.

roof_pocket_shape.doc: Roof pocket (only used if roof_pocket_rise > 0): shape of the rise along the depth, 1 = straight ramp, 2 = parabola.

led_x.doc: Lateral position of the LED in the roof (it lights the Qi pad and the plugs), from the cubby centreline. It sits in the middle.

led_y.doc: Distance from the front lip to the centre of the roof LED. Guess: the middle of the cubby.

roof_bulge_depth.doc: The roof bulges down slightly in the middle, with the LED at its centre: how far its lowest point is below H_cubby. 0 = flat roof. Guess.

roof_bulge_diameter.doc: Diameter of the roof bulge, modelled as a smooth round bump centred on the LED. Guess.

W_lip.doc: Narrowest width of the opening at the front lip, at shelf height. Only used to check that the shelf can be inserted flat. Estimate.

H_ports_top.doc: Highest point of the plugs WITH your real adapters and cables inserted, above the Qi pad. Measure your longest 12 V adapter.

H_ports_bottom.doc: Lowest point of the plug cluster above the Qi pad. Preview only.

X_ports.doc: Lateral centre of the port cluster, from the cubby centreline (+ = right as seen from the driver).

W_ports.doc: Lateral width of the port cluster including plugs, adapters and cables.

D_ports.doc: How far plugs, adapters and cable bends stick out from the rear wall into the cubby.

qi_center_x.doc: Lateral centre of the Qi charging spot (where the phone lies).

qi_center_y.doc: Distance from the front lip to the centre of the Qi charging spot.

phone_length.doc: Phone length incl. case. The phone is assumed to lie crosswise (long side along x).

phone_thickness.doc: Phone thickness incl. case and camera bump.

shelf_height.doc: Height of the shelf's TOP surface above the Qi pad. Default 58: about 20 mm above it for a drawer, 50 mm below it for the phone and plugs. Must clear your plugs (H_ports_top).

front_recess.doc: How far the shelf's front edge sits behind the front lip (hides the shelf, looks closer to stock).

rear_gap.doc: Gap between the shelf's rear edge and the rear wall.

side_gap.doc: Gap per side between the shelf edge and the side wall (see envelope_offset). 0 = exactly the size of the fitted envelope at that height. Negative = bigger (press fit). Use the pad thickness if you add felt/foam.

envelope_offset.doc: How far your car's side walls are outside the estimated envelope. Read it off the fit coupon: the gap you see per side when side_gap is 0.

corner_radius_front.doc: Corner radius of the shelf's front corners (cosmetic).

port_notch_width.doc: Width of the cut-out in the shelf's rear edge over the port cluster. 0 disables the notch.

port_notch_depth.doc: How far the notch reaches forward into the shelf, from its rear edge. (The brief's port_notch_height: the notch is a through-cut, so it has a depth, not a height.)

port_notch_offset_x.doc: Lateral shift of the notch centre relative to X_ports.

port_clearance.doc: Minimum air gap the checks demand around plugs and cables.

phone_clearance_min.doc: Minimum free height under the lowest part of the shelf, for the phone on the Qi pad plus room to slide it in and out.

led_keepout_diameter.doc: Free zone around the roof LED (the LED itself is about 15 mm): no part may be built inside this circle, from the roof down to the Qi pad, so the LED stays uncovered and still lights the charger and plugs. 0 = no free zone.

wall_thickness.doc: Thickness of the shelf skirt, ribs and drawer walls.

frame_width.doc: Width of the solid rim around the grid, seen from above.

frame_height.doc: Height of the solid edge band, from the deck top down (skirt). This band is what touches the side walls.

rib_count.doc: Number of stiffening ribs under the deck, running side to side.

roof_clearance.doc: Gap between the roof plate's front strip and the cubby roof.

roof_depression_start.doc: Front strip of the roof plate that stays at full height, from its front edge.

roof_depression_depth.doc: How much lower the rest of the roof plate is (clears the roof bulge and the LED). 0 = flat.

roof_depression_ramp.doc: Length of the smooth (cosine) transition. Longer = gentler overhang when printed standing; see max_overhang_deg.

perforate_roof.doc: Perforate the roof plate (its lowered, flat part).

perforation_style.doc: Hole shape. Both print without support with the part standing on its rear edge: the upper edges rise at perforation_tip_angle. teardrop = round with a pointed top; diamond = straight bars of one width.

perforation_open_fraction.doc: Share of the perforated area that is open (material removed). The bar width follows from it.

perforation_tip_angle.doc: Angle of the holes' upper edges from vertical when printed standing. Smaller = taller holes, safer printing.

perforation_margin.doc: Solid border between the holes and the plate's edges.

drawer_type.doc: flip = tip-out drawer on a hinge; slide = pull-out drawer on rails.

drawer_width.doc: Outer drawer width. null = derive from the shelf.

drawer_depth.doc: Outer drawer depth. null = derive from the shelf.

drawer_height.doc: Outer drawer height. null = derive from the free space above the shelf.

hinge_position.doc: Pivot axis of the flip drawer. front_bottom = tip-out bin whose top tilts toward the driver.

open_angle.doc: Flip drawer: rotation at the open end stop.

pin_diameter.doc: Hinge pin diameter (printed pin, or 1.75 / 2.85 mm filament). No metal near the Qi coil.

clearance_sliding.doc: Gap per side for sliding fits (drawer on rails). Tune me for your printer.

clearance_hinge.doc: Radial gap for hinge pins and knuckles. Tune me.

clearance_press_fit.doc: Gap for parts that are pressed together. Tune me.

coupon_plate_thickness.doc: Fit coupon: thickness of the flat outline plate (a few layers).

coupon_flange_width.doc: Fit coupon: width of the plate ring, measured inward from the outline. The centre is open.

coupon_rim_width.doc: Fit coupon: wall thickness of the rim that stands on the outline.

coupon_rim_height.doc: Fit coupon: rim height incl. the plate. null = frame_height, so the coupon has the same edge band as the real shelf.

gauge_y.doc: Profile gauge: depth behind the lip of the cross-section it reproduces (it stands vertically in the cubby there).

gauge_band.doc: Profile gauge: width of the frame along the outline. The middle is open. At most 10 mm: wider bands no longer follow the curved edge of the roof pocket.

gauge_clearance.doc: Profile gauge: gap to the cubby on every side, on top of envelope_offset.

gauge_corner.doc: Profile gauge: chamfer at its four corners, so a rounded transition in the car cannot hold it off the walls. 0 = sharp; otherwise at least 0.7 x (gauge_band + gauge_clearance), smaller values are raised to that.

min_bar_width.doc: Warn if the bars between perforations are thinner (default = 2 perimeters at a 0.4 mm nozzle).

max_overhang_deg.doc: Steepest overhang (from vertical) for parts printed standing on their rear edge: the roof ramp and the rear corners are kept within it.

min_wall.doc: Warn if walls or rims are thinner.

min_deck_thickness.doc: Warn if the shelf deck is thinner.

arc_segments_per_90.doc: Arc tessellation for the pure-Python STL/3MF export (segments per 90 degrees).
